# Parameter Specification: WARPR

**CRITICAL CONTRACT:** This specification is immutable during implementation. Stage 1 Planning cannot proceed without this file. All subsequent stages reference these exact parameters.

**Generated by:** UI mockup finalization (ui-mockup skill, ui-finalization-agent)
**Source of truth:** `.ideas/mockups/v9-ui.yaml` (finalized 2026-11-11) + `v9-ui-test.html`
**Referenced by:** Stage 1 (Foundation), Stage 2 (DSP), Stage 3 (GUI)
**Plugin name:** WARPR is a working title. Parameter IDs do not contain the plugin name and survive a rename.

## Total Parameter Count

**Total:** 135 parameters registered in the APVTS (115 host-automatable + 20 non-automatable LFO grid-snap settings)

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| Sample | 8 |
| Granular | 12 |
| Warp | 9 |
| Shaper | 6 |
| Envelope | 4 |
| Filter | 8 |
| Global | 8 |
| LFO 1-10 (8 each) | 80 |

Types: Float 62, Int 5, Bool 5, Choice 63.

APVTS conventions:
- `juce::ParameterID{ id, 1 }` (version hint 1) for every parameter; IDs are **case-sensitive** and used verbatim as WebView relay names.
- Choice parameters use `juce::AudioParameterChoice`; Bool use `AudioParameterBool`; Int use `AudioParameterInt`; Float use `AudioParameterFloat` with `NormalisableRange<float>(min, max, interval, skew)`.
- `lfoNGridX` / `lfoNGridY` (20 parameters) are editor snap settings: register them with `withAutomatable(false)` (`AudioParameterChoiceAttributes`) so they persist in state but do not clutter host automation lists.
- Parameter order in the APVTS layout is the exact order of the Parameter Definitions below (Sample, Granular, Warp, Shaper, Envelope, Filter, LFO 1..10, Global).
- Choice lists are append-only after release (removing an entry re-indexes saved automation; keep dead entries instead).

## Parameter Definitions

## Sample

### sampleStart
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 0.001
- **UI Control:** START knob (sm) + draggable START line on waveform
- **DSP Usage:** Playback start as fraction of sample length; must stay < sampleEnd

### sampleEnd
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 1
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 0.001
- **UI Control:** END knob (sm) + draggable END line on waveform
- **DSP Usage:** Playback end as fraction of sample length

### rootNote
- **Type:** Int
- **Range:** 0 to 127 MIDI note
- **Default:** 60
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 1
- **UI Control:** TUNE stepper (C3 = 60)
- **DSP Usage:** Note at which the sample plays at original pitch

### transpose
- **Type:** Int
- **Range:** -24 to 24 semitones
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 1
- **UI Control:** SEMI knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Pitch offset in semitones

### fineTune
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** -100 to 100 cents
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 0.1
- **UI Control:** FINE knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Pitch offset in cents

### loopMode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 3 choices (index 0-2)
- **Default:** Forward Loop (index 0)
- **Choices:** Forward Loop | Ping-Pong | One-Shot
- **UI Control:** LOOP select
- **DSP Usage:** Loop behaviour between start/end

### direction
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 2 choices (index 0-1)
- **Default:** Forward (index 0)
- **Choices:** Forward | Reverse
- **UI Control:** Direction toggle (arrows)
- **DSP Usage:** Playback direction

### playMode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 2 choices (index 0-1)
- **Default:** Classic (index 0)
- **Choices:** Classic | Granular
- **UI Control:** CLASSIC/GRANULAR toggle in SOURCE header
- **DSP Usage:** Selects classic sample playback or the grain engine

## Granular

### grainMode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 3 choices (index 0-2)
- **Default:** Classic (index 0)
- **Choices:** Classic | Loop | Cloud
- **UI Control:** CLASSIC/LOOP/CLOUD toggle
- **DSP Usage:** Classic = 2 overlapping grains/ch; Loop = crossfading playback with random position; Cloud = up to 20 unsynced grains/ch

### grainPosition
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** POSITION knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Read position inside [sampleStart,sampleEnd]; first-class mod destination

### grainScan
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** SCAN knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Scan speed of the note-on position ramp; 0 = no scan (exponential map to ramp time, DSP-defined)

### grainScanDist
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** -1 to 1 normalised bipolar
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** DIST knob (xs), bipolar
- **DSP Usage:** Scan end position relative to grainPosition

### grainScanLoop
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** On/Off
- **Default:** On (true)
- **UI Control:** SCAN LOOP/OFF toggle
- **DSP Usage:** On = scan restarts at end; Off = scan stops at end

### grainScanKey
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** On/Off
- **Default:** Off (false)
- **UI Control:** SCAN KEY/OFF toggle
- **DSP Usage:** On = scan speed follows note pitch

### grainSize
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 2 to 2000 ms
- **Default:** 80
- **Skew Factor:** skew for centre 80 (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`)
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** SIZE knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Grain length; changes apply after the current grain completes (click-free)

### grainShape
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0.5
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** SHAPE knob (xs); disabled in Cloud
- **DSP Usage:** Grain-envelope morph (sharp attack -> crossfade -> exp attack); crossfade length in Loop; ignored in Cloud

### grainVariation
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** VAR knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Master per-grain randomisation amount; distributed internally over position (0-2 s), size, transpose (Cloud) and volume

### grainSpread
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** SPREAD knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Stereo detune of L/R grains + grain-start offset

### grainReverse
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** 8th grain slot (REV %) - active in Loop mode only
- **DSP Usage:** Probability that a grain plays reversed (Loop mode)

### grainDensity
- **Type:** Int
- **Range:** 1 to 20 grains
- **Default:** 8
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 1
- **UI Control:** 8th grain slot (DENSITY) - active in Cloud mode only
- **DSP Usage:** Number of simultaneous unsynced grains per channel (Cloud mode)

## Warp

### warpEnable
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** On/Off
- **Default:** On (true)
- **UI Control:** On-box left of mode select
- **DSP Usage:** Bypasses the warp stage when off

### warpMode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 60 choices (index 0-59)
- **Default:** Sine Fold (index 17)
- **Choices:** see Choice Lists below (warpMode)
- **UI Control:** Full-width grouped select (5 groups, 60 modes)
- **DSP Usage:** Warp algorithm; every entry is an independent implementation. Default 'Sine Fold'

### warpAmount
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** WARP knob (md)
- **DSP Usage:** Shared warp amount; primary mod destination

### warpParamA
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0.5
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** A knob (sm)
- **DSP Usage:** Mode-specific secondary parameter A

### warpParamB
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** B knob (sm)
- **DSP Usage:** Mode-specific secondary parameter B

### modOscSource
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 5 choices (index 0-4)
- **Default:** Sample (index 4)
- **Choices:** Sine | Triangle | Saw | Square | Sample
- **UI Control:** MOD OSC select
- **DSP Usage:** Modulator for FM/PM/AM/RM/Cross modes; 'Sample' uses the loaded sample itself

### modOscRatio
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.25 to 16 x
- **Default:** 1
- **Skew Factor:** skew for centre 2 (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`)
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** RATIO knob (sm)
- **DSP Usage:** Modulator frequency ratio relative to the carrier

### oversampling
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 4 choices (index 0-3)
- **Default:** 2x (index 1)
- **Choices:** 1x | 2x | 4x | 8x
- **UI Control:** OS select
- **DSP Usage:** Oversampling factor wrapped around nonlinear stages

### warpMix
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0 (changed 2026-11-20: stage ships enabled but dry; raising MIX brings it in)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** MIX knob (sm)

## Shaper

### shaperEnable
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** On/Off
- **Default:** On (true) (changed 2026-11-20: armed by default, silent through shaperMix 0)
- **UI Control:** On-box on shaper page
- **DSP Usage:** Bypasses the waveshaper stage when off

### shaperCurveSelect
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 2 choices (index 0-1)
- **Default:** A (index 0)
- **Choices:** A | B
- **UI Control:** A/B toggle
- **DSP Usage:** Selects which curve the editor, preset, RESET and NORM act on

### shaperMorph
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** MORPH knob (md); displays A/B/percent
- **DSP Usage:** Crossfade between transfer curves A (0) and B (1)

### shaperPreset
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 9 choices (index 0-8)
- **Default:** Custom (index 8)
- **Choices:** Soft Sat | Hard Clip | Tube | Diode | Fold | Sine | Triangle | Expo | Custom
- **UI Control:** Preset select
- **DSP Usage:** Loads the named analytic curve into the selected curve; 'Custom' = user-edited (editing a point sets it to Custom)

### shaperSymmetry
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 2 choices (index 0-1)
- **Default:** Symmetric (index 0)
- **Choices:** Symmetric | Asymmetric
- **UI Control:** SYM/ASYM vertical toggle (ONLY control added vs v9 mockup)
- **DSP Usage:** Symmetric: x>=0 half defines an odd-symmetric curve; Asymmetric: independent positive/negative control

### shaperMix
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0 (changed 2026-11-20: stage ships enabled but dry; raising MIX brings it in)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** MIX knob (sm)
- **DSP Usage:** Dry/wet of the shaper stage

## Envelope

### ampAttack
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.1 to 10000 ms
- **Default:** 1  *(changed 2026-11-12 by owner: neutral playback defaults - anti-click only)*
- **Skew Factor:** skew for centre 50 (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`)
- **Step:** continuous

- **Type:** Float

- **Skew Factor:** skew for centre 300 (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`)
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** D knob (md) + draggable handle
- **DSP Usage:** Amp envelope decay

### ampSustain
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 1  *(changed 2026-11-12 by owner: neutral playback defaults - decay is a no-op until lowered)*
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** S knob (md) + draggable handle (vertical)
- **DSP Usage:** Amp envelope sustain level

### ampRelease
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 1 to 20000 ms
- **Default:** 50  *(changed 2026-11-12 by owner: neutral playback defaults - clickless, no smear)*
- **Skew Factor:** skew for centre 400 (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`)

## LFO 1-10 (per-LFO parameter set, repeated 10 times)

Every LFO N in 1..10 owns the 8 parameters below. All 10 sets are registered up-front (the host parameter list is static); the UI shows 3 LFOs by default and `+` reveals more (`lfoCount` is state, not a parameter). IDs are `lfo` + N + suffix, e.g. `lfo1Mode`, `lfo10GridY`.


### lfo<N>Mode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 4 choices (index 0-3)
- **Default:** Retrig (index 1)
- **Choices:** Free | Retrig | Env | Mono
- **UI Control:** Mode rail (FREE/RETRIG/ENV/MONO)
- **DSP Usage:** Phase reset behaviour

### lfo<N>Dir
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 3 choices (index 0-2)
- **Default:** Forward (index 0)
- **Choices:** Forward | Reverse | Ping-Pong
- **UI Control:** Direction toggle
- **DSP Usage:** Playback direction of the LFO shape

### lfo<N>Sync
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 2 choices (index 0-1)
- **Default:** Sync (index 1)
- **Choices:** Hz | Sync
- **UI Control:** HZ/SYNC toggle
- **DSP Usage:** Free-running Hz or host-tempo divisions

### lfo<N>Rate
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0.375
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** RATE knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Hz mode: 0.01*5000^v Hz (0.01-50 Hz); Sync mode: division index round(v*16) into the 17-entry table

### lfo<N>Phase
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 360 degrees
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** 1
- **UI Control:** PHASE knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Start phase offset

### lfo<N>Smooth
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0 to 1 normalised
- **Default:** 0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Step:** continuous
- **UI Control:** SMOOTH knob (xs)
- **DSP Usage:** Output smoothing amount

### lfo<N>GridX
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 10 choices (index 0-9)
- **Default:** 8 (index 4)
- **Choices:** 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 12 | 16 | 24 | 32 | OFF
- **UI Control:** X grid select (editor snap)
- **DSP Usage:** UI-only snap setting; persisted (non-automatable)

### lfo<N>GridY
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** 6 choices (index 0-5)
- **Default:** 8 (index 2)
- **Choices:** 2 | 4 | 8 | 12 | 16 | OFF
- **UI Control:** Y grid select (editor snap)
- **DSP Usage:** UI-only snap setting; persisted (non-automatable)

**Full LFO ID list (exact, for the layout builder and relay table):**

- LFO 1: lfo1Mode, lfo1Dir, lfo1Sync, lfo1Rate, lfo1Phase, lfo1Smooth, lfo1GridX, lfo1GridY
- LFO 2: lfo2Mode, lfo2Dir, lfo2Sync, lfo2Rate, lfo2Phase, lfo2Smooth, lfo2GridX, lfo2GridY
- LFO 3: lfo3Mode, lfo3Dir, lfo3Sync, lfo3Rate, lfo3Phase, lfo3Smooth, lfo3GridX, lfo3GridY
- LFO 4: lfo4Mode, lfo4Dir, lfo4Sync, lfo4Rate, lfo4Phase, lfo4Smooth, lfo4GridX, lfo4GridY
- LFO 5: lfo5Mode, lfo5Dir, lfo5Sync, lfo5Rate, lfo5Phase, lfo5Smooth, lfo5GridX, lfo5GridY
- LFO 6: lfo6Mode, lfo6Dir, lfo6Sync, lfo6Rate, lfo6Phase, lfo6Smooth, lfo6GridX, lfo6GridY
- LFO 7: lfo7Mode, lfo7Dir, lfo7Sync, lfo7Rate, lfo7Phase, lfo7Smooth, lfo7GridX, lfo7GridY
- LFO 8: lfo8Mode, lfo8Dir, lfo8Sync, lfo8Rate, lfo8Phase, lfo8Smooth, lfo8GridX, lfo8GridY
- LFO 9: lfo9Mode, lfo9Dir, lfo9Sync, lfo9Rate, lfo9Phase, lfo9Smooth, lfo9GridX, lfo9GridY
- LFO 10: lfo10Mode, lfo10Dir, lfo10Sync, lfo10Rate, lfo10Phase, lfo10Smooth, lfo10GridX, lfo10GridY

**LFO rate mapping (UI + DSP must agree):**
- `lfoNSync = Hz`: `hz = 0.01 * 5000^rate` (0.01 Hz - 50 Hz, log).
- `lfoNSync = Sync`: `index = round(rate * 16)` into `["8 bar","4 bar","2 bar","1 bar","1/2","1/4.","1/4","1/4T","1/8.","1/8","1/8T","1/16.","1/16","1/16T","1/32","1/32T","1/64"]` (slowest to fastest; "." = dotted, "T" = triplet). Default rate 0.375 = "1/4".

## Parameter Groups


**Sample:** sampleStart, sampleEnd, rootNote, transpose, fineTune, loopMode, direction, playMode

**Granular:** grainMode, grainPosition, grainScan, grainScanDist, grainScanLoop, grainScanKey, grainSize, grainShape, grainVariation, grainSpread, grainReverse, grainDensity

**Warp:** warpEnable, warpMode, warpAmount, warpParamA, warpParamB, modOscSource, modOscRatio, oversampling, warpMix

**Shaper:** shaperEnable, shaperCurveSelect, shaperMorph, shaperPreset, shaperSymmetry, shaperMix

**Envelope:** ampAttack, ampDecay, ampSustain, ampRelease

**Filter:** filterEnable, filterType, filterCutoff, filterResonance, filterDrive, filterMorph, filterKeyTrack, filterMix

**Global:** voiceMode, polyphony, unisonVoices, unisonDetune, unisonSpread, glideTime, bendRange, masterGain

**LFO 1-10:** see full LFO ID list above.

## Non-Parameter State (persisted in plugin state `<WARPR_UI_STATE>` child; NOT automatable)

These items are part of the preset/host state contract. They are transported to the UI as one JSON document (`warpr_getUiState` / `warprUiState` event) and written back through dedicated native functions. Stage 2 owns the C++ model; Stage 3 owns the UI.

1. **Embedded sample audio.** Sample file name, original sample rate, channel count and the decoded PCM (lossless, e.g. 32-bit float or FLAC-compressed block) are stored inside the state so presets/projects reopen intact. Ships with a built-in default single-cycle wave (also embedded/regenerated) so a fresh instance makes sound.
2. **`lfoCount`** (int 1..10, default 3).
3. **LFO shapes** - array of `lfoCount` objects (wire format; `v` = value 0..1, 1 = top):
   `{ "preset": "CUSTOM|SINE|TRIANGLE|SAW UP|SAW DOWN|SQUARE|PUMP|STEPS 4|STEPS 8|STEPS 16|SWING|S&H NOISE|DRIFT", "points": [{"x":0..1,"v":0..1,"c":-1..1}], "bends": [{"x":0..1,"v":0..1}], "table": [8 floats]|null, "drift": {"a":rad,"b":rad}|null }`
   - `CUSTOM`: `points` (sorted by x, >= 2, segment curve exponent `2^(3c)` on the segment starting at the point); `bends` empty.
   - Preset ids: shape is the exact analytic function (listed in v9-ui.html `presetFn`; DSP must implement identically); `bends` are local smoothstep-blended offsets over the analytic curve; `S&H NOISE` uses the stored 8-value `table`; `DRIFT` uses stored phases `a`,`b` (`0.5 + 0.26 sin(2 pi t + a) + 0.14 sin(4 pi t + b)`). Random values are generated once by the UI at pick time and stored, so UI and DSP always agree.
   - LFO output is bipolar for modulation: `mod = 2*v - 1`.
4. **Mod matrix** - array of `{ "src": 1..10 (LFO number), "dst": "<parameterId>", "depth": 0..1 }`. `dst` may be any Float/Int knob parameter shown in the UI. v9 UI shows/edits one source per destination; the schema allows several. Depth is a fraction of the destination's normalised range; applied as `norm' = clamp(norm + depth * mod, 0, 1)`.
5. **Shaper curves** - `{ "A": curve, "B": curve }`, each `{ "interp": "smooth"|"linear", "points": [{"x":-1..1,"y":-1..1}] }` sorted by x; first/last points sit at x = -1 / +1. Default = identity `(-1,-1),(0,0),(1,1)`. Symmetric mode uses only the x >= 0 half (odd-symmetric mirror). `smooth` = monotone cubic Hermite (Fritsch-Carlson) - identical in UI and LUT builder. `shaperPreset` (parameter) regenerates the selected curve from a C++ preset library; point edits set it to `Custom`.
6. **State version** - integer `warprStateVersion` (start at 1) for migration.

## Removed From Earlier Mockups (must NOT exist)

`loopXfade`, `startRandom`, `playbackSpeed`, `sampleGain`, `filterGain`, `fltAttack`, `fltDecay`, `fltSustain`, `fltRelease`, `filterEnvAmount`, `grainPitchJitter`, `grainWindow`. (No filter envelope. Cutoff modulation = LFO matrix only.)

## Notes

- Parameters are implemented in EXACT order during Stage 2 (Shell)
- Parameter IDs must remain consistent across all stages
- UI controls are implemented from finalized mockup (`v9-ui.html`) during Stage 3 (GUI)
- Defaults for demo-valued controls are the neutral "Init" values listed above (mockup display values such as WARP 38% / CUTOFF 1.2 kHz were illustrative); they may be changed only by amending this file and `DEF` in v9-ui.html together.
- `warpParamA/B` meaning is mode-specific; Stage 2 must document the meaning per mode alongside the DSP (no placeholder modes).
- `grainVariation` is a single master amount; per-target sub-amounts (position 0-2 s, size, transpose, volume) are internal fixed weights, not parameters.

> **Owner change (2026-11-13):** ampAttack minimum 0.1 ms -> 0.0 ms and default 1.0 ms -> 0.0 ms, by
> direct user instruction ("i want the attack to be at 0.0ms"). AmpEnvelope clamps a 0 ms attack to one
> sample (instant; click-free re-attack semantics unchanged). Note: the normalised mapping of saved
> host automation shifts marginally at the bottom of the range.
